en: A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a massive crowd filling a street or plaza. Most people wear wide‑brimmed hats; some are on horseback and many hold umbrellas. In the center, people carry a large protest banner in Spanish. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century political demonstration or revolutionary rally, possibly reproduced as a historical postcard.
